@ModuleInfo(name="Sprint", description="Sprints without holding the key", category="Movement", enabled=true) public final class ExampleSprint extends Module
The smallest useful module: an annotation, one setting, one handler.

Note what is absent. No settings list, no registration call, no subscribe/unsubscribe in the lifecycle hooks, no constructor. A module that needs none of those writes none of them.
